title: Apply Photo Picker, FileProvider, and Clipboard Privacy
prompt: Add travel-photo import, secure itinerary PDF sharing, and explicit address copying with URI validation, bounded streams, narrow grants, and process-death recovery.
successCriteria: Capability, permission, user education, and fallback states are explicit.
Stable identity reconnects system results with current durable state after recreation.
Adverse tests cover denial, cancellation, absence, duplication, interruption, and privacy.
hints: Write the user promise and fallback before calling the platform API.
Test the callback after destroying the screen or process that launched it.
solutionOutline: Model capability and durable intent, then request the smallest user-controlled access.
Validate returned data, clean resources, reconcile state, and record adverse evidence.
verification: Run deterministic state and contract tests.
Exercise the feature on representative API levels and real hardware where required.
